content.title: Which Stores Are Open and Closed on Easter 2024? A Complete Guide
content.text: Trader Joe's, Walgreens and Walmart are among the stores that will remain open on March 31 this year Published on March 29, 2024 09:00AM EDT Easter Stores 2024. Credit : Mario Tama/Getty The only thing you should be hunting for on Easter is eggs, not stores open on the holiday — which is why we've created a comprehensive guide to which retailers and grocery stores will be closed on March 31 this year. If you do happen to need a last-minute Easter basket stuffer or crucial ingredient for your Easter feast, there's good news! A variety of stores like Whole Foods and Dollar General are keeping their doors open on the holiday to fulfill your shopping needs. However, not all stores across the country have the same hours of operation. Therefore, it's important to check the retailer or grocer in your location via its website to save you the trouble before taking the drive. Keep scrolling for which stores are open and closed on Easter Sunday this year. Confirmed stores that will be closed on Easter Sunday 2024: Easter chocolate bunnies on a shelf.
